expected_source: which frames are accepted follows the filtering rules in SPRU975E section 2.10: the unicast frame matching the address RAM slot, the broadcast frame with RXBROADEN set and the multicast frame whose six-bit hash bucket is set in MACHASH1 are transferred, while the unicast frame for another address and the multicast frame with a clear hash bucket are filtered by address matching; the address-matching frame longer than RXMAXLEN is a long frame, so section 2.10.7 makes it oversized and RXCEFEN keeps it out of memory while section 5.49.11 keeps it out of RXFILTERED; the counters and the teardown marker FFFF FFFCh come from the same document, and the checksum was computed in Python
